title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our comprehensive guide, comparing prices and contract terms from popular franchises
intro: Auckland's fitness scene is thriving, with numerous gyms across the city offering a range of membership options. With prices starting from $15 per week, there's something for every budget. From commuter-friendly gyms in the CBD to 24/7 facilities in the suburbs, we've got you covered.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD is home to a number of gyms, catering to busy professionals and commuters. Some popular options include City Fitness, which offers a 12-month contract for $29.95 per week, and Jetts Fitness, which has a $20 per week membership with no lock-in contract.

sections.heading: Gyms in North Shore
list: Jetts Fitness Rosedale: $20 per week, no contract
Anytime Fitness Takapuna: $25 per week, 12-month contract
Snap Fitness Albany: $22 per week, 6-month contract

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: For those who want to fit in a workout on their way to or from work, there are several gyms in Auckland that offer convenient locations and flexible membership options. One popular choice is Jetts Fitness, which has gyms in the CBD and on the North Shore, with prices starting from $20 per week.

sections.heading: More Information
sections.body: For more information on specific gyms in Auckland, including prices, contract terms, and amenities, check out our individual gym guides. For example, you can learn more about Jetts Fitness and its various locations across the city on our Jetts Fitness page.
